The current native calculations recover both historical conventions and isolate their difference to dispersion at identical temperature, density and composition.
Excluding same-sign ion pairs also reproduces the published LiBr model line within its digitization envelope; including them does not.
This is numerical verification of historical implementation values and a published model curve, not physical validation.
The report has not been independently reviewed or promoted for manuscript use.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import json, os
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
p = Path(os.environ.get('FIGIEL_CROSSWALK_LEAF', '.')).resolve()
read = lambda name: json.loads((p / 'results/data' / name).read_text())
c = json.loads((p / 'inputs/comparison.json').read_text()); run = read('run.json')
states, activities, refs, failures = (read(n+'.json') for n in ['states','activities','references','failures'])
checks = pd.read_csv(p / 'results/data/crosswalk.csv')
def table(title, frame):
    print('\n### '+title+'\n\n'+frame.to_markdown(index=False, floatfmt='.10g')+'\n')
print(f"The states use {c['temperature_K']} K and {c['pressure_Pa']} Pa, with formula molality in mol salt/kg water. Native execution returned {run['state_calls']} explicit states, {run['activity_calls']} activities and {run['reference_calls']} references in {run['wall_seconds']:.6g} s; {run['failed_calls']} native failures were retained.")
table('Fixed comparison criteria', pd.DataFrame(c['tolerances'].items(), columns=['criterion','value']))
print('Pressure roots use each returned native convergence criterion. Figure 5 uses the mean relative digitization uncertainty as the aggregate error bar. '+c['packet_resolution'])
table('Historical replay and consistency', checks.groupby(['group','quantity'], sort=False).agg(rows=('passed','size'), passing=('passed','sum'), max_absolute_error=('absolute_error','max'), minimum_tolerance=('tolerance','min'), maximum_tolerance=('tolerance','max')).reset_index())
a = pd.DataFrame(activities); curve = a[a.chart == 'figure-5'].copy(); summary = []
for choice, group in curve.groupby('convention', sort=False):
    error = group.absolute_relative_error.mean(); envelope = (group.uncertainty/group.source_gamma).mean()
    summary.append(dict(convention=choice, points=len(group), mean_absolute_relative_error=error, envelope=envelope, maximum_uncertainty_ratio=group.uncertainty_ratio.max(), reproduced=bool(error <= envelope)))
table('Figure 5 model-line verification', pd.DataFrame(summary))
table('Every digitized model-line comparison', curve[['convention','molality','source_gamma','uncertainty','gamma','signed_relative_error','absolute_relative_error','uncertainty_ratio']])
gamma = checks[checks.group == 'gamma'].copy(); gamma['relative_error'] = gamma.delta/gamma.reference
table('Every historical activity comparison', gamma[['convention','salt','molality','native','reference','delta','relative_error','passed']])
r = pd.DataFrame(refs); table('Native infinite-dilution diagnostics', r[['convention','salt','log_fugacity','molality','convergence_error']])
table('Historical reference comparisons', checks[checks.group == 'reference'][['convention','salt','quantity','native','reference','delta','passed']])
s = pd.DataFrame(states); paired = s[s.chart == 'exclusion-density'].pivot(index=['salt','molality'], columns='convention', values=['hard_chain','dispersion','association','born','debye_huckel','residual_helmholtz','bulk_relative_permittivity'])
diff = paired.xs('all-pairs', axis=1, level=1)-paired.xs('exclusion', axis=1, level=1)
table('Matched-density all-pairs minus exclusion, reduced energies', diff.reset_index())
witness = s[(s.salt == 'KCl') & (s.molality == c['molalities_mol_kg'][-1]) & (s.chart == 'exclusion-density')]
table('KCl witness and off-root pressure', witness[['convention','molality','molar_density','dispersion','pressure','compressibility_factor','log_fugacity_unavailable_cause']])
root = s[s.chart == 'pressure']; table('Native pressure-root diagnostics', root[['convention','salt','molality','pressure_error_Pa','pressure_density_derivative']])
print(f"Euler operands exist for {len(checks[checks.group == 'euler'])} explicit states. At {sum(s.compressibility_factor <= 0)} off-root states, nonpositive compressibility makes ln(Z) undefined; their reduced terms remain available. These are density-chart evaluations, not failed pressure solves.")
print('Native failures: '+json.dumps(failures)+'. Historical replay, isolation and native-consistency failures: '+checks[checks.passed != True].to_json(orient='records')+'.')
normalization = []
for choice, path in c['historical'].items():
    old = json.loads((p.parents[2]/path).read_text()); rows = [v for salt in old.values() for v in salt['rows']]
    normalization.append(dict(convention=choice, archived_ares_unit='J/mol' if choice=='exclusion' else 'dimensionless', maximum_basis_check_error=max(abs(v['ares']/(run['gas_constant_J_per_mol_K']*c['temperature_K'])-sum(v[k] for k in ['hard_chain','dispersion','association','born','debye_huckel'])) if choice=='exclusion' else abs(v['ares']-sum(v[k] for k in ['hard_chain','dispersion','association','born','debye_huckel'])) for v in rows)))
table('Archived Helmholtz bases, compared as reduced quantities', pd.DataFrame(normalization))
print('Engine source commit: `'+run['source_commit']+'`. Engine provenance: `'+str(run['engine'])+'`. Loaded extension SHA-256: `'+run['extension_sha256']+'`.')
table('Effective native solver settings', pd.DataFrame(run['solver_options']))
table('Consumed input identities', pd.DataFrame(run['input_hashes'].items(),columns=['path','sha256']))
```

At fixed density, the unchanged hard-chain, association, Debye–Hückel and Born contributions, together with the total-energy balance, support an isolated dispersion cause.
The changed dispersion also changes pressure closure and ionic fugacities; the native activity calls use each declaration's own infinite-dilution reference.
The per-state operands, convergence criterion and component availability are retained in [states.json](results/data/states.json); all signed historical comparisons are in [crosswalk.csv](results/data/crosswalk.csv).
The tables answer the scalar replay and term-isolation checks directly; a plot would not strengthen those checks.

The independent paper comparator is the orange LiBr **model line** in Figure 5, right panel, article PDF page 7, of [Figiel, Yu and Held (2025)](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.iecr.5c00475).
The [digitization method](../2025-figiel/figures/figure-05/source/libr-model-digitized.md) owns its calibration and row uncertainties; no experimental markers or occluded concentrations are reconstructed.
The aggregate envelope is a source-resolution criterion, not a confidence interval or a guarantee that each point lies within its uncertainty.
The maximum pointwise uncertainty ratio therefore remains visible even for the passing declaration.
Tables 1–5, Eqs. (1)–(4), (11), and (20)–(22) of that article supply the model inputs and conventions; the Born term uses [the correction to Eq. (7)](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.iecr.6c01415) already owned by the Engine.

The archived binaries and their exact installed commits are unidentified.
Their raw outputs remain byte-for-byte in [superseded.json](results/data/superseded.json) and [greenfield.json](results/data/greenfield.json), with original packet fingerprints where available.
Agreement with these values supports a historical numerical replay, without establishing execution of the old binary or equation-by-equation equivalence.
The former comparison subtracted unlike Helmholtz bases; the current table compares the archived five-term reduced sums and preserves the original dimensional values separately.
The earlier rounded same-density README values used a slightly different water molar mass and are superseded by exact archived compositions here.
Terminal reference changes describe the native stopping diagnostic, not a rigorous bound on total reference error.
Published fitted-parameter rounding, digitization and physical model adequacy remain separate limits.

The [README](README.md) gives the rerun command; [comparison.json](inputs/comparison.json) owns the fixed criteria and source paths, and [run.json](results/data/run.json) records input hashes, policy defaults, source identity and timing.
The [historical literature audit](results/like-ion-dispersion-convention.md) remains provenance for the earlier diagnosis; the present evidence is the native paired experiment above.
The broader Figiel reproduction belongs to issue #748 and is outside this comparison.
